correctness.rationale: The deformed Gaussian kernel formula follows by the same convergent complex Gaussian integral as Qin's lemma. The quaternionic coefficient cancellations are unchanged under the scalar deformation. Linear-composition singular values give explicit membership in every Schatten class when all coordinate contractions are strict, while tensor factorization proves noncompactness at zero passive damping. Explicit rays verify nondecay/nonradiality, and a homogeneous-degree exponential-polynomial argument proves both factors have infinite rank.

originality.rationale: Qin's current v1 uses full Gaussian decay and does not state compactness, trace-class, Schatten, or the nondecaying endpoint. Searches did not locate the explicit bounded nondecaying all-Schatten zero-product pair or the passive compactness threshold. Bauer--Le 2011 remains the principal residual risk because its full text was not inspected; Lin--Lu--Zu 2026 may subsume the individual weighted-composition representation, which is therefore not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result shows that the active Gaussian decay in the recent bounded zero-product construction is unnecessary: in two dimensions the symbols can remain macroscopic at infinity while both factors belong to every Schatten ideal. In higher dimensions the same family has an exact noncompact/all-Schatten transition controlled by passive damping, separating symbol decay from operator smoothing.
